description: Source code for WiFi steering configuration handling, including encoding, decoding, translation, and memory management functions for steering config subdocuments in a web configuration context.

methods.name: init_steering_config_subdoc
methods.description: Initializes steering config subdocument with predefined objects.

methods.name: access_check_steer_config_subdoc
methods.description: Performs access check for steering config subdocument.

methods.name: translate_from_steering_config_subdoc
methods.description: Translates steering config subdocument data to OVSDB or TR181 formats.

methods.name: translate_to_steering_config_subdoc
methods.description: Translates steering config subdocument data from OVSDB or TR181 formats.

methods.name: free_steering_config_entries
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for steering configuration entries.

methods.name: encode_steering_config_subdoc
methods.description: Encodes steering configuration into JSON format.

methods.name: decode_steering_config_subdoc
methods.description: Decodes JSON steering configuration into internal data structures.
